terms.title: Booking terms
terms.intro: These terms apply when you book a trip or an experience through {app}. Please read them before you pay.

who.title: Who you book with
who.text:
The trip is offered and run by the operator named on the booking page and on your ticket. Your contract for the trip is with that operator.

{app} provides the booking, payment and ticketing technology on the operator's behalf. If someone (for example your hotel's reception) recommended the trip or booked it for you, they did so as the operator's partner.

booking.title: Booking and payment
booking.text:
Prices are shown in the operator's currency and include VAT. Your seats are held for a few minutes while you pay; the booking is confirmed when the payment succeeds, and you then receive your ticket by email or SMS.

Card payments are processed by Stripe. Neither the operator nor {app} sees or stores your card details. If the operator allows it, a partner may book for you with payment at boarding; in that case you pay the operator when you board.

ticket.title: Your ticket
ticket.text: Your ticket is valid for the date, time and number of people shown on it. Its QR code is scanned at boarding and can be used only once. Keep it on your phone or save the PDF; you do not need to print it.

yourCancel.title: If you want to cancel or change
yourCancel.text: The operator's cancellation policy applies. It is shown on the booking page before you pay and on your ticket. To cancel or change your booking, contact the operator using the details on your ticket.

operatorCancel.title: If the operator cancels
operatorCancel.text: Trips on the water and outdoors depend on the weather and on safety. If the operator calls off your trip, you are told by email or SMS and the full amount you paid online goes back to the card you used, usually within 5 to 10 business days. The operator may also offer you another date.

onTheDay.title: On the day
onTheDay.text: Arrive at the meeting point shown on your ticket a little before the departure time. Follow the crew's safety instructions. The operator may refuse boarding to keep passengers safe.

liability.title: Responsibility and complaints
liability.text: The operator is responsible for running the trip. Send any complaint about the trip to the operator first. These terms do not limit the rights you have as a consumer under the law of your country.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For your booking, contact the operator using the details on your ticket. For a question about {app} itself, use our contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How your personal data is used when you book through {app} or write to us.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.text:
For a booking, the operator you book with is responsible for your data (the controller). {app} processes the data on the operator's behalf, only to provide the booking, payment and ticketing service.

For messages you send from our contact page, {app} is the controller.

data.title: What data
data.text:
Your name, email address or phone number, the language you chose, the trip, date and tickets you booked, the payment status, and, if someone booked for you, your hotel room number when given. Card details are collected by Stripe and never reach the operator or {app}.

If you arrived through a partner's link or QR code, we keep a code that identifies that partner, so their commission can be calculated.

purposes.title: Why it is used
purposes.text:
To make and manage your booking (the contract you ask for): send your ticket, check it at boarding, tell you about changes or cancellations and send refunds. To pay the partner who recommended the trip their commission and to keep the accounting records the law requires.

We do not use your data for advertising and we do not sell it.

recipients.title: Who receives it
recipients.text: The operator and their staff. The partner who recommended the trip or booked it for you sees the booking and your name. Service providers that work for us under contract: Stripe for payments, email and SMS providers to send your ticket, and the hosting provider that stores the data.

retention.title: How long it is kept
retention.text: For as long as needed to provide the trip and handle any questions about it, and afterwards for as long as accounting and tax law require for the payment records.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask for a copy of your data, for it to be corrected or deleted, for its use to be restricted, to object to its use, and to receive it in a portable format. Write to the operator using the details on your ticket. You can also complain to your national data protection authority (in Romania: ANSPDCP, dataprotection.ro).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We use only the cookies the service needs: one remembers the language you chose, and, if you came through a partner's link or QR code, a few remember which partner recommended the trip (with a random visit code, so repeated clicks count once) so the booking counts for them. There are no advertising cookies and no tracking across other websites.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For your booking data, write to the operator using the details on your ticket. For anything about {app} itself or the contact page, use our contact page.
